blocks.prompt: 4. Find the equations of the tangents to the circle \(x^2 + y^2 - 4x - 2y - 4 = 0\), which are parallel to the line \(3x - 4y + 2 = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Is circle ka centre origin par nahi, is liye \(c^2 = a^2(1 + m^2)\) wala formula yahan seedha nahi lagta.
Diya kya hai? Circle \(x^2 + y^2 - 4x - 2y - 4 = 0\) aur line \(3x - 4y + 2 = 0\).
Find kya karna hai? Is line ke parallel do tangents.
Rule kaunsa? Har circle ke liye: line tangent hai jab centre se us ka faasla radius ke barabar ho.
Plan: centre aur radius nikalo, parallel line \(3x - 4y + k = 0\) likho, faasla = radius se \(k\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^2 + y^2 - 4x - 2y - 4 = 0\); tangents \(3x - 4y + 2 = 0\) ke parallel.
Maloom karna: tangents ki equations.
Tareeqa: Line tab hi tangent hai jab centre se us ka perpendicular faasla radius ke barabar ho. Parallel lines mein sirf constant term ka farq hota hai.

Centre aur radius
\[g = -2,\ f = -1,\ c = -4\]
\[\text{centre} = (2, 1),\quad r = \sqrt{4 + 1 + 4} = 3\]
Kyun: 6.1.3 ka working rule: centre \((-g, -f)\), radius \(\sqrt{g^2 + f^2 - c}\); \(-c = +4\). \(x\) ke coefficient \(-4\) ka aadha \(-2\), us ka negative 2; \(y\) ke coefficient \(-2\) ka aadha \(-1\), negative 1. Is tarah centre \((2, 1)\).
Dhyan dein: Is circle ke liye \(c^2 = a^2(1 + m^2)\) lagana ghalat hai; woh condition sirf origin wale circle \(x^2 + y^2 = a^2\) ke liye hai.

Required lines
\[3x - 4y + k = 0 \quad (1)\]
Kyun: \(x\) aur \(y\) ke coefficients wohi rakhe to slope wohi rahega; sirf \(k\) maloom karna hai.

Centre se faasla = radius
\[\dfrac{|3(2) - 4(1) + k|}{\sqrt{3^2 + (-4)^2}} = 3\]
\[|2 + k| = 15\]
Kyun: Perpendicular distance formula \(\frac{|ax_1 + by_1 + c|}{\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}}\), centre \((2, 1)\) rakha. Denominator \(\sqrt{25} = 5\), to \(|2 + k| = 15\).

\(k\) nikalein
\[2 + k = 15 \Rightarrow k = 13\]
\[2 + k = -15 \Rightarrow k = -17\]
Kyun: Modulus ka matlab hai andar wali cheez \(+15\) bhi ho sakti hai aur \(-15\) bhi; isi se do tangents aate hain.
Dhyan dein: Sirf \(k = 13\) le lena aam ghalti hai.

Tangents
\[3x - 4y + 13 = 0,\quad 3x - 4y - 17 = 0\]
Kyun: Har \(k\) ko (1) mein rakha.

Tasdeeq
\[y = \tfrac{3x + 13}{4}:\ 25x^2 - 10x + 1 = (5x - 1)^2 = 0\]
Kyun: Pehli line circle mein rakhi (aur 16 se multiply kiya) to repeated root aaya, yani sirf ek point \(\left(\frac{1}{5}, \frac{17}{5}\right)\) par chhooti hai. Doosri line \(\left(\frac{19}{5}, -\frac{7}{5}\right)\) par chhooti hai. Ek aur aasaan tasdeeq: dono tangents ke darmiyan faasla \(\frac{|13 - (-17)|}{5} = 6\) hai, jo bilkul diameter (\(2 \times 3\)) ke barabar hai, jaisa do parallel tangents ke liye hona chahiye.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein yeh jawab key 4 nahi balke key 5 ke taur par chhapa hai, kyunke Exercise 6.2 ki numbering ek qadam khisak gayi hai (Question 2 dekhiye). Tangents \(3x - 4y + 13 = 0\) aur \(3x - 4y - 17 = 0\) sahi hain.
